data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 for David Muster, setting the income tax at 11,405.00 € and requiring an additional payment (Nachzahlung) of 634.00 € by 30.04.2026.
data.explanation: This is your official tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) from the tax office for the year 2025. It shows your taxable income was calculated at 52,300 € and the tax owed is 11,405.00 €. Since 10,771.00 € was already withheld from your salary, you need to pay the remaining 634.00 € to the tax office by the stated date, using the reference number given. If you disagree with the assessment, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office by the deadline shown, in writing, electronically via ELSTER, or in person. If you miss it, the assessment becomes final. Consider consulting a tax advisor (Steuerberater) if you want to challenge any figures.
